notes:
Author page 42 has 19 main baseline rows including a display labelled (22)|(21), one long interlinear parenthesis, the small insertion cette, a slanted marginal arithmetic qualification and later foliation 84. No diagram or drawing is present. The page states injectivity of G_m(S) into its completion/H^1(S,T) in the arithmetic case, then distinguishes geometric splittings from all splittings of (13), treating the former as a remarkable sub-torsor that should itself be characterized in a complete profinite description of absolute algebraic geometry over Q. It then begins a question about specialization of sections of extensions of type (1) into type (2), in the case tentatively read as corps de valuation. These are the manuscript's assertions. The first reader made no independent mathematical proof, use-check or computation; the later formal injectivity check 085-N1 is recorded separately below and in check_events. The whole image and each full-resolution half were viewed once; every running word, abbreviation, symbol, index, arrow, punctuation mark, insertion and deletion was checked against both witnesses. Fifteen single crops cover every word disagreement and every other open place. The marginal crop was rotated clockwise 13 degrees; all boxes refer to the original image. No decided place was recropped. The first margin reads arithm without an independent stop. Gamma_i is clear here. The descender of quand crosses the initial word of the interlinear parenthesis; car remains doubtful rather than reading that descender as a t. The parenthesis is inserted between géométriques and ceux-ci; its final words are tt court with one closing parenthesis. The cancelled terminal s and H^1(S,T) remain doubtful. A cancelled relation immediately after H^1(S,T), recovered in blind adjudication, also remains doubtful between equals and isomorphism. The G_m(S) superscript is a real, live retraced mark compatible with a hat but not resolved; it is not silently removed to make the torsor statement mathematically expected. The long descender of forment reaches the following G_m capital without cancelling it. The small cette attaches after de and before description through its curved leader. The suspected extra hyphen in géom. alg. is only the elongated abbreviation point, followed by a separate small a; no hyphen is added. At the final paragraph the singular extension is favoured, but the connected final stroke might be compressed s, hence a new extension/extensions doubt. valuation is certain, while the compressed preceding corps de remains doubtful. No OCR, external research, unrelated page inputs or TeX compilation was used.

Root check 085-N1: for any abelian group A, the kernel of A → lim_n A/nA is exactly the intersection of all nA, since each coordinate is the residue class modulo nA. Thus absence of nonzero elements divisible by every positive integer implies injectivity. In multiplicative notation this is the intersection of the subgroups of n-th powers. This verifies the formal injectivity step, not the manuscript’s arithmetic assertion about G_m(S), nor the cohomological identification or the torsor claim. No reading was changed by this check.

Blind adjudication: the display label retains (22)/(21) doubt because its second digit is a compressed curved stroke without a fully separated foot. The right edge after géométriques has only one independently surviving closing quote tick, and the terminal s/e return remains doubtful. A cancelled relation after H^1(S,T), omitted on first pass, is now retained with equals/isomorphism doubt. Complete is left without an accent not visible above its e. Gamma_i remains the two-branched class sign matching 081/082, not xi/zeta. All eleven token-different boxes were inspected.

check_events.outcome: Verified ker(A → lim_n A/nA) = intersection_n nA coordinatewise; injectivity follows when that intersection is zero. Arithmetic unit-group hypothesis, H^1 identification and torsor assertion were not proved.
